title: Florodude's Really Lame Room Quest
author: florodude

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Hello all, I have decided to release my first room. Yes, I said that correctly, this map is one room. Why am I releasing a one-room map? To prove to myself I can do it. So before you start posting things like, “This is lame” “This is so dumb.” “Piece of poop.” Realize that I understand the map sucks. Why Are You Releasing Such a Dumb Map? I am releasing this one room map for the purpose of getting myself out there as a mapper. I made this map in less than a day, mostly just to prove I could finish it. Now that it is done, I can move on to bigger and better things. I don’t expect anybody to play this map or like it. I simply want to do it to prove to myself that I can release a map so I can have motivation moving forwards Map Features One Wall Gun Mystery Box Juggs PAP …Yup that’s about it.

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
